tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events

steps.what: Participate in campus and community events and engage attendees

tasks.design: Retain teacher participation and contact with attendees. Existing {CALENDAR} details support attendance but do not replace the time spent engaging the community.
tasks.previous_blocker: Participation depends on presence and responsive interaction.
tasks.enabler_now: No evidence establishes a substitute for teacher participation.
tasks.still_hard: Responding to different interests and building local relationships.
tasks.human_edge: Make personal connections and explain educational work in context.

reach.task: Connect community activities with learning programmes
reach.learn: Community priorities and suitable educational formats

evidence.claim: Community event participation remains relational effort; model knowledge offers no basis for removing attendance time.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher participation, excluding event production, venue booking and communications managed by event staff.
Event organiser supplies the existing programme. No new structured participant record or automated interaction is assumed.
Use existing calendar arrangements first. No changed workflow creates upkeep.
research_questions: Which event interactions depend on the teacher's direct presence?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Participation and attendee interaction retain their full time; no booking baseline is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Search specialised materials against outside reading assignment objectives
Select readings and verify bibliography metadata in the reference manager {OTHER}
Compile the bibliography in the required citation style
Check the compiled bibliography and release the reading assignment

tasks.design: Configure the reference manager {OTHER} to format a teacher-verified reading collection into the required citation style for {LMS}. The teacher retains discovery, relevance selection, source verification and the final assignment check; no generated title is treated as an existing publication.
tasks.previous_blocker: Citation details are repeatedly typed and reformatted after readings are chosen.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference collections and citation styles can render verified metadata.
tasks.still_hard: Reading difficulty, relevance, source existence and learner access.
tasks.human_edge: Choose materials that extend the particular assignment appropriately.
tasks.altitude: Less citation formatting; academic selection remains unchanged.

reach.learn: Catalogue validation, editions and access rights

evidence.claim: Scopus AI offers topic summaries and foundational papers, supporting discovery assistance rather than guaranteed bibliography accuracy or measured savings.
Native reference-manager citation formatting from checked metadata is model knowledge; the proposed saving concerns formatting alone.

assumptions: Boundary is bibliography compilation and release, excluding reading the assigned materials as students and wider research synthesis. Library catalogue in s1 and reference manager in s2 are the categories represented by {OTHER}.

Teacher produces verified title, authors, year, edition, publisher, DOI or catalogue reference, access link and selected status in s2. All 35 hours include catalogue resolution, metadata capture and missing-field correction. Citation style is selected and checked within s3's setup upkeep; unresolved sources remain manual or are omitted before generation.

Test native collection export first. Do not assume a model-generated citation exists; selection and final checking retain full time. Four focal upkeep hours cover style changes and malformed metadata.
research_questions: Is formatting still manual after existing reference-manager functions are considered?

already_counted.description: Selection, source resolution and metadata capture
Final bibliography and assignment release check

incremental.description: Citation style and metadata exception upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Exact bibliography text, editions, access links, assignment and destination version; changes require renewed release approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+35+0+10=80, gross=20, upkeep=4, net=16. High assumes currently manual citation formatting with verified metadata. Low assumes native formatting already runs or unusual references remain manual. Discovery and source checking retain time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Act as advisers to student organizations on plans, responsibilities and difficulties

tasks.design: Keep the teacher as adviser in discussions with student representatives. Existing {DOCS} guidance can be consulted, while advice, trust and the students' own choices remain human work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice depends on the organisation's situation and student development.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability removes the need for contextual discussion.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing support, independence and institutional responsibilities.
tasks.human_edge: Ask difficult questions without taking over student ownership.
tasks.altitude: Advising time and decision rights remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Advising student organisations relies on contextual judgement and relationships; no digest capability establishes an advising-time saving.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher advice, excluding student organisation administration and separate academic advising.
Student representatives produce concerns and plans in existing discussion. No structured readiness score or automatically generated advice is assumed.
Use native document access first. Unchanged discussion adds no upkeep.
research_questions: Which issues require referral beyond the adviser?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Student-organisation advising retains all time, without an invented paperwork stage.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Understand the government or industry consulting question and educational context
Provide professional consulting advice on curricula, methods or education policies

tasks.design: Retain scoped professional advice and dialogue with the client. Existing {DOCS} evidence supports the conversation; the digest does not establish that an automated draft replaces consulting judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice must fit the client's educational aims, constraints and responsibilities.
tasks.enabler_now: No validated consulting substitute is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Applying educational evidence to unfamiliar organisational situations.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge the brief and explain the practical limits of recommendations.
tasks.altitude: Consulting judgement, client interaction and authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Client context, evidence limits and implementation constraints

evidence.claim: Contextual professional consulting remains human work; model knowledge does not establish a saving from the digest's grading or discovery tools.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher consulting advice, excluding separately contracted research, reports and client implementation. Do not invent a report-writing baseline for every engagement.
Client representatives produce the question and context through unchanged scoping discussion; teacher clarifies them in s1. No structured policy-fit input is assumed.
Test native evidence access first. No changed consulting system introduces upkeep.
research_questions: Does the actual engagement contain a separate repetitive artefact stage worth redesigning?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+60=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Scoping and advice retain time; document production is not assumed to exist in every consulting task.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Bibliography formatting can shrink where still manual; community participation, student organisation advice and consulting remain human commitments.
reach: Coordinate specialised reading collections with librarians
Support student-led activities with instructional coordinators
role.ambitious_version: An education teacher with checked reading lists and protected time for community relationships and professional advice.
